speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
text: asked the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources what is the cost of the 320 sensors installed in Singapore's potable water supply pipelines to detect water leakages from the pipelines.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: The data analytics and simulation tools developed as part of the system are used to help plan operations and minimise water supply disruption.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: PUB will continue to improve the reliability and coverage of the sensor network system.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Leak detection is one function of the system.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Nevertheless, the sensor network system is just one component of PUB's leak management programme.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: PUB will continue to work closely with the industry to develop and improve sensing capabilities and leak detection technologies.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Concurrently, PUB is actively looking at new ideas and innovations that will help minimise water losses due to leaks and ensure 24/7 supply of good water to customers.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Just a short supplementary question for the Senior Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Does one of the possible solutions of the leak management and technological programme include going into possible reduction of evaporation from reservoirs?

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Is that one of the measures being undertaken?

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: This water sensor network system, as I have said, fulfils a number of functions.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: Leak detection is just one of the functions of the sensor network system.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: The sensor network system helps PUB in terms of monitoring the performance of its water distribution network by monitoring network pressure, water quality and water flow, and so on.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: In fact, it is necessary and it is important for the data obtained from this to be in real-time because it helps PUB in terms of planning for its operation as well as identifying and responding to anomalies and to minimise water supply disruption.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: For instance, when there is a water leak incident and the PUB field crew is sent to respond to the incident, they can use the sensor data as well as the software simulation tools to plan for their operations to identify potential risks, and then to be able to take appropriate actions in order to isolate and carry out repair works whilst monitoring this operation as well as the water quality as they are undertaking the repairs.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: This, again, helps to minimise the water disruption incidence.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: With regard to the other areas where PUB continues to look at how it can minimise water losses, due to leaks as well as other causes, one of the areas would be evaporation loss, say, from the reservoirs.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: It requires multiple applications because the material will degrade under sunlight.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: So, it has not been taken up, but they will continue to look at different areas in order to be able to minimise water losses as well as to supply good quality water 24/7 to its customers.

speaker: Mr Azmoon Ahmad (Nominated Member)
text: I just have one supplementary question to the Senior Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Azmoon Ahmad (Nominated Member)
text: How much improvement has been made before and after the implementation of the new technology for the leak detection?

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: As I have said, for this sensor network system, leak detection is only one of its functions.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: A main function of this sensor network system is to monitor the performance of the water distribution network in real-time and to help PUB plan its operations.
